tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mdos thams cad kyi dkris byed tshul bzhugs so// rang bzhin rnam dag ngo bo stong pa'i gshis/ /ma 'gag lhun gyis grub pa don gyi mdangs/ /sna tshogs mos ngor gang 'dul 'gro ba'i mgon/ /ston mdzad drin can bla ma la btud nas/ /mdos kyi thags kyi rim pa bshad par bya ste/ /thog de yang mar khyung tshang khru chings kyi/ /'thags lugs 'di rim pa 'di bzhin kho na ltar ro/ /srog shing gi logs la bug pa drug phug par/ /steng dang 'og tu bug pa mtshams bzhin gyi/ /yas dang man thad kyi bug pa gnyis gnyis dkar mnyam par bya zhing / /bar gyi bug de yan man gyi mtshams su 'ong bar bya/ pa 'di 'phred kyi snyug ma ji ltar byas pa bzhin dgos pa'i cha gcig lhag tsam gyi bar bar gyi steng 'og tshad bya/ phyogs bzhi yi/ /drang thal cha mnyam por 'ong bar bya/ /che chu tshang chung gyis tshad mdos kyi ji ltar byed pa'i snyug rkang ring thung zlos bcad nas bcug /snyug ma'i rkang steng dang bar 'phrin las tshugs pa'i 'og rnams la/ /steng 'og mtshams su bzhi bzhi dar bar phyogs su 'byung ba'i 'og ma nas brtsam te ser por 'og bar/ /thog mar ser po nas ser por g.yas gcus dang de bzhin mthing dmar ljang rnams kyang ngo / rim bzhin chos bskor du gyen 'dzegs te/ /rtser phyin pa slar yang phyin shul ser po rang gi stengs bab te/ /de nas du thur te g.yas bskor du bab chos skor phyin/ /de bzhin du mthing mi rtag dang ga dmar go'i rtags dang ljang dgu'i rtags/ /gnas bkra shis sngar bzhin thags su byas shing khyad par du yang / /ljang gur sa'i stegs kyi stengs du mar babs pa'i thog steng dang thog dang bar dang /

/'og thog rnams ma rim pa bzhin dus skal pa'i btags nas ni/ /rtsa srog shing gi bar babs pas tshar gcig 'khor ba/ /de bzhin du ma khad pa'i bar du btags so/ /tshon gyi spel lugs 'og nas khang bzang ma'i gsham du 'byung bzhin no/ /khyung tshang khang bzang ma'i thags lugs ni/ /srog shing la sgrom ni chos drug 'di bzhin du legs par bca' ste/ /srog shing gi gang ba der steng du 'og so so ru/ /bug pa 'i steng 'og gi bar phred la rus pa'i shing gis phyed lhag tsam byed cing dpal khye med na phyed rang byed dam gnyis gnyis phug pa la/ /che khyung tshang chung gi sdug la ring grung ji byed 'dod ltar rigs tshad byed kyi/ /snyug phyogs bzhi nas ma bsdus nas snyug ma de nyid la/ /gcig gnyis yang ser mthing dmar ljang rtags can gsum bzhi'i aṅki rnams/ /steng gi phred shing dang 'og gi phred shing gnyis thad dkar bris pa pang bar la/ /rim pa bzhin du gcig gnyis dang gnyis gsum rnams la/ /srog gi rtsa ba ni ang ki gcig nas bzung shing nas ni ang ki rtags rnams la/ /yar 'dzegs g.yas mdos ngo bas brgyud rtser phyin te/ /mar ang ki gcig rang gi bab g.yon nas brgyud rtsa bar de thur du phyin/ /khyad par du bzhi ang ki pa yar la 'dzegs ni sa/ /gong ang ki gcig gnyis gsum ltar byas rjes rtse mo nas mar babs pas/ /steng ang ki bzhi lnga mar bab ste gnyis steng gi bskal/ /logs logs kyi rgya gram gnyis kyi thags tshul ni/ /steng ang ki'i bzhi nas ni 'og dang ang ki por/ /phyin cing steng gi gnyis ang ki 'og gi gsum ang ki par/

/phyin te steng ang ki bzhir 'og la phyin pa sngar shul log /de nas g.yon du brgyud 'og gi de gur babs thog gnyis skal zhing / /rgya gram thags lugs ni 'og gi ang ki bzhi nas ni steng gi ang ki dang por/ /phyin cing 'og gi ang ki gnyis pa nas steng gi ang ki gsum par/ /phyin te 'og gi ang ki bzhir sngar shul du logs nas/ /srog 'og gi shing la dkris pa ni tshar gcig go /de ltar ma khengs pa'i bar du btags pa/ /tshon gyi spel lugs ni lha de'i sku mdog ltar nang bcug nas du btags/ /mthing lha gnas chen kyang kha yin na de yi phyir/ /ser 'ja' rnams so dmar ljang dkar rim bzhin no/ /lha dkar po yin na gnas chen kyang dkar po de phyir du 'ja' rim/ /mthing ser dmar ljang dkar po'o/ /ser po dbus zhugs de yi phyir/ /dmar mthing ljang dkar rim ltar ro/ /dmar po dang nag po ni tha la ma spang bya'o yin pa/ /de bzhin du tshon spel lugs rig pas 'dres su shes par yin/ /gur te gdugs kyi shing sgrom cho lu ni mthong brgyud ltar go bde bar 'gyur zhing / /rtsibs gdugs kyi ma 'ang bcu drug pa dang bcu gnyis pa dang / /brgya pa dang drug pa rnams che chung khyad par gi /rgyas pa dang 'bring po dang bsdus pa dang dang shin tu bsdus pa rnams so/ /gdugs kyi thog gi ris mo gnas ma'i thags tshul ni/ /bcu drug gdugs rkang rkang la bar du ni gnas ma/ /sd+yeng bzhi bzhi bar du bzhag te btags pa las/ /thog gi ri mo rigs tshar khyud gcig tu 'khor ba'i rjes su/

/tha zlum por ma 'khor gcig bskor min pa ba'o/ /tshon gyi spel lugs gong bzhin khang bzang ba'i skabs gdugs rtsibs no/ /bcu gnyis kyi rkang la gnas la 'gro ba'i bar dag tu/ /gsum gsum dor nas btags pa las/ /chos 'byung lta bu 'byung re re de'i rjes su/ /de nas de ba'i rtsa rang gi rkang phar cig zlum por phyin te/ /sngar bzhin lan du chos 'byung gcig shar rtsa nar gcig phyin pa gsum phyin pa las/ /thog rigs shar rjes tha ma zlum por bskor ro/ /brgyad kyi gdugs rtsigs ma rkang la bar du gcig pa zhag nas phyin pas/ /khru bzhi pa gcig byung rjes phar lta'i rtsa ba'i rkang la cig phyin/ /de bzhin gong bzhin bar du rkang gcig gcig bzhag nas phyin pas/ /slar yang gru bzhi pa gcig shar byung ba'i rjes su/ /tha ma zlum por bskor zhing slar yang gang ma 'ja' ris bcas bran/ /gdugs kyi rtsibs ma bcu drug gi mar gyi sna la/ /skug tshad lta bu'i cha mnyam pa brgyad byas pa'i kyi snag tsha'i thig bya pa re/ /de la thags tshul ni 'di ltar yin te/ /aṅki gcig nas kyis brgyad bar du/ /gong du phyin te ngam stod nas rim par ang ki gcig nas brgyad bar btab pa yis/ /phred la gcig nas gang du gcig tu phyin/ /gcig nas gnyis su phyin de nas bzhi gnyis gsum du/ /phyin ching gsum nas bzhir drug phyin nas/ /de nas bzhi bzhi lngar phyin te lnga nas drug tu phyin te/ /drug nas bdun du phyin te bdun nas brgyad du phyin pa/ /de rnams thur du babs pa'o/ /slar yang brgyad nas gyen du yar 'dzegs te/

/bdun du phyin cing bdun nas drug tu phyin/ /drug nas lngar phyin lnga nas bzhir tu phyin/ /bzhi nas gsum phyin gsum nas gnyis su phyin/ /gnyis nas gcig tu phyin pa bzhin du ma 'khor ba'i bar du de ltar ro/ /de ltar 'ja' ris dang bcas ma khengs bar du btags/ /stod kha khyer tsag tshar gyi tshag drug tu legs par btab/ /de yi gnyis thags tshul ni 'di ltar ro/ /de kha'i span dang man du phred du re re phyin/ /gzhan ni gong bzhin khyad par cing / /bcu gnyis rkang la tshad drug bya/ /kha khyer tshad bzhi legs par bya/ /brgyad kyi rkang la tshad lnga bya/ /kha khyer tshad gsum byed pa'o/ /'thag tshul gong bzhin khyad par med/ /tshon spel gong du bstan bzhin no/ /'di rnams thams cad mthong brgyud kyi/ /phyag len khong chud man ngag yin/ /yi ge 'di mthong rang gis ni/ /rtog par ni bka' yin nam bas de'i phyir na khong chud gces pa ni man ngag go /bkra shis/ mdos kyi gdugs rkang brgyad la/ thig lnga yod pa'i dkri lugs steng nas rim bzhin gcig nas gcig la dkri/ rim bzhin lnga thub mar dkri/ bzhi nas gcig thub yar dkri/ yang gcig nas gcig la dkris nas 'bab 'jog gong bzhin bskor ba 'grig gong sa la mas nas rim bzhin gcig nas gcig la dkri/ de nas gnyis la/ de nas gsum la/ yang gsum pa dkri/ yang gnyis nas gcig nas gcig la/ yang gnyis/ yang gnyis nas gsum la dkri/ des rigs 'gre'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ mdos thams cad kyi dkris byed tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
